headline_item.event_summary_en:
ByteDance co-founder Zhang Yiming is now Asia’s richest person, with an estimated fortune of more than $105bn, putting him ahead of Indian industrialist Gautam Adani, according to Bloomberg. The ranking comes from the Bloomberg Billionaires Index, and Zhang, 43, has never held the top spot before.

The figure is an estimate, and other trackers disagree. Forbes’ real-time list put Zhang’s net worth at $84bn on Wednesday. The gap comes largely from how each list values ByteDance, a private company

【行业研判】该数字是估计值，其他追踪器不支持。

headlines.title_zh: 亚马逊发布Strands Decider v2系列开源模型
headlines.title_en: AWS debuts Strands Decider v2, a family of five open decision models based on Google's Gemma 4, ranging from 2B to 31B parameters, under the Apache 2.0 license (Frederic Lardinois/The New Stack)
headlines.author: The New Stack
headlines.event_summary_zh: 亚马逊推出基于Google Gemma 4架构的五款开源决策模型，参数规模涵盖2B至31B，采用Apache 2.0协议
headlines.event_summary_en: Amazon has launched the Strands Decider v2 model family, featuring five decision-making models based on Google's Gemma 4 architecture, ranging from 2B to 31B parameters. All models are released under the Apache 2.0 license to facilitate customized enterprise decision-making tasks.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】亚马逊(Amazon Web Services)在云基础设施生态系统：发布Strands Decider v2模型家族，包含5款基于Gemma 4的模型
【起因与机理】强化云端决策模型产品矩阵，提升企业级用户部署自主权
【关键数据与实测】参数规模从2B至31B，完全遵循Apache 2.0开源协议。
【各方立场与态度】旨在降低企业决策类任务的部署成本与技术门槛。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Amazon Web Services (AWS) (Cloud infrastructure ecosystem): Launched Strands Decider v2 family with 5 models based on Gemma 4
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Strengthen cloud decision-model portfolio and provide deployment autonomy for enterprise users
[Key Metrics] Parameter range 2B-31B, licensed under Apache 2.0.
[Key Position & Outlook] Lowering barrier for enterprise decision-making tasks.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 通过适配Gemma 4架构并采用宽松的开源协议，亚马逊试图加速在云原生决策智能领域的标准化布局，意在降低特定行业任务的开发门槛。此举将进一步挤压闭源模型在中小规模企业决策场景的溢价空间，迫使模型供应商加速向差异化推理服务转型。
headlines.industry_impact_en: By adopting the Gemma 4 architecture and open licenses, AWS is accelerating the standardization of cloud-native decision intelligence to lower development barriers. This move compresses the pricing power of proprietary models in niche decision scenarios, forcing providers to pivot toward differentiated inference services.

headlines.title_zh: 思科与OpenAI启动开源基础设施防护计划
headlines.title_en: Cisco and OpenAI launch Shirudo open-source infrastructure shield to prevent AI-driven cyberattacks
headlines.author: Mike Wheatley
headlines.event_summary_zh: 思科与OpenAI联手发布安全基础设施项目及Shirudo工具，旨在应对AI加速带来的“零日”自动化网络攻击
headlines.event_summary_en: Cisco's VP of Engineering and Security CTO Thomas Graf has partnered with OpenAI to launch the 'Secure Infrastructure Project,' featuring an open-source tool called Shirudo that utilizes immutable architecture and reinforcement learning for proactive defense. This initiative addresses the critical threat where AI-driven vulnerability exploitation precedes public disclosure, shifting security from reactive patching to resilient, design-based protection.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】思科系统工程副总裁兼安全CTO Thomas Graf、OpenAI集团在企业级安全基础设施构建领域：发布安全基础设施项目，并推出Shirudo开源防御工具
【起因与机理】应对AI驱动的网络攻击导致漏洞修复周期失效的现实风险
【关键技术规格】核心动因：应对AI驱动的自动化漏洞挖掘与负向防御时间窗口。
【行业影响与走向】后续影响：推动行业从补丁式安全向设计即安全（Secure-by-Design）转型。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Thomas Graf (VP of Engineering and Security CTO at Cisco Systems), OpenAI Group PBC: Launch of the Secure Infrastructure Project and the Shirudo open-source tool
[Root Cause & Mechanism] To counter the threat of AI-driven cyberattacks that outpace traditional manual patching
[Key Fact Detail] Core driver: Addressing the negative time window for vulnerability exploitation caused by AI-driven automation.
[Industry Impact & Outlook] Future impact: Shifting the industry toward a 'Secure-by-Design' paradigm instead of reactive patching.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 安全防御逻辑正从“漏洞修补”向“架构免疫”范式转移，此合作标志着传统网络巨头开始通过集成AI原生的防御模型来重塑云原生算力边界。Shirudo通过强化学习实现的自我防御机制，将显著提高算力平台的防御韧性，这可能迫使云服务提供商重构其底层TPM（可信平台模块）信任链以满足合规审计要求。
headlines.industry_impact_en: Security paradigms are shifting from reactive patching to architecture-based immunity, with this collaboration marking the integration of AI-native defense models into legacy network infrastructure. By leveraging reinforcement learning for self-defense, Shirudo forces a re-evaluation of TPM-based trust chains, likely setting a new standard for cloud-native infrastructure security.

celebrity.author: Yann LeCun
celebrity.author_role_zh: Meta 首席AI科学家 / 深度学习三巨头 / 图灵奖得主
celebrity.quote_zh:
@FutureJurvetson @elonmusk @kimmonismus 背景：
“在过去 20 年的大部分时间里，我一直在尝试训练模型进行视频预测，但在前 15 年基本上失败了。直到我意识到必须放弃生成模型并使用联合嵌入预测架构 (JEPA)”

“过去几年，JEPA 和世界模型开始发挥作用。主要应用是物理世界、机器人和工业过程控制。Meta 对这些东西不是特别感兴趣”

但我的项目始终得到扎克、博兹、施雷普和克里斯·考克斯的支持。

确实，作为首席人工智能科学家，我虽然是高级副总裁级别，但却是一名 IC。公司最好的工作！

我从未攻读过法学硕士，这也是事实。我非常支持 FAIR 的 LLM 项目（例如后来成为 Llama 的项目），并在说服 Mark 围绕 Llama 创建人工智能优先产品部门方面发挥了作用，并推动开源 Llama-2。但我从来没有参与过技术层面的工作。
celebrity.quote_en:
@FutureJurvetson @elonmusk @kimmonismus Context:
"I've tried to train models to do video prediction for the better part of the last 20 years, and largely failing for the first 15. Until I realized you had to abandon generative models and use joint embedding predictive architectures (JEPA)" 

"Things started to work in the last few years with JEPA and world models. The main applications are in the physical world, robotics, and industrial process control. Things that Meta is not particularly interested in" 

But my project always had the support of Zuck, Boz, Schrep, and Chris Cox. 

It's true that, as Chief AI Scientist, I was at senior VP level but was an IC. Best job in the company! 

Also true that I never worked on LLMs. I was very supportive of LLM projects at FAIR (e.g. the project that became Llama), and played a role on convincing Mark to create an AI-first product division around Llama, and pushed to open source Llama-2. But I was never involved at the technical level.
celebrity.thesis_zh: 深入探讨世界模型与自监督的关键演进，直指核心工程落地与技术范式转移。
celebrity.thesis_en: Dissecting crucial inflection points in World Models & SSL, highlighting system trade-offs and engineering shifts.

tool_item.pain_point_zh: 编码代理自主生成代码时常不自觉引入反序列化、注入或权限绕过漏洞，传统人工审计耗时且容易遗漏隐蔽攻击面。
tool_item.pain_point_en: Autonomous coding agents frequently introduce subtle vulnerabilities that manual code reviews miss under tight deadlines.

零云端数据外泄：在本地隔离环境中执行规则检测，保障企业专有代码私密安全
key_features_en: Multi-Phase Independent Verification: Executes threat modeling, taint analysis, and boundary audits on diffs
Machine-Readable Audit Evals: Formats findings so coding agents can self-heal vulnerabilities automatically
